_comment: mask_config.json - per-model tuning for make_masks.py, keyed by model folder: skin_threshold / hair_threshold (colour distance, default 12 / 15), hair_seed (back | crown), skin_seed (forehead: for a beard over the nose and cheeks), cheek_below_nose (default 0.04), nohair, no_cloth_rivals (bare arms / scales that differ from the face: don't treat them as clothes), skin_max_x (skin only within this share of the height from the middle: sleeves the very colour of the skin).
